description: Permanently delete connectors from your Besidka account: their sign-in is revoked at the server when it supports that, and their stored credentials, tool settings and per-chat settings are removed. Chats and the record of past tool calls stay. This cannot be undone: ask the user to confirm first and send confirm: true. Reports the ids that were deleted and the ones that are not yours. Requires signing in (connectors:write).

confirm.description: Must be true, confirmed by the user

name: delete_connectors
title: Delete connectors
